text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Phew... That was a wonderful bath.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
A free-flowing hot spring that warms you right to the core...
Hehe, I ended up soaking for way too long.

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for your visit.
Please do come again—

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
The open-air bath renovations will be finished by next week.
I'm sure it will offer a breathtaking view.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, yay♪
So I can relax in this hot spring again...
I'll do my best with training starting tomorrow!
